groups.description:

Ciprofloxacin: 500 mg twice a day
groups.title: Arm 1 = BioThrax (0.5 mL) + Ciprofloxacin (500 mg Bid) + PK

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Per protocol population: all subjects in arm 1 who received any dose of ciprofloxacin, had adequate PK data on Day 5 and Day 44, had received all three BioThrax doses, and who had no key protocol deviations (e.g., insufficient blood sample) that would be expected to affect the ciprofloxacin PK assessment.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Ratios of Ciprofloxacin Area Under the Curve and Cmax (Day 5/Day 44)
